verdict.rationale: Heap documents several server-side APIs (track, bulk track, identify, account properties, user deletion), but the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe returned 404 on all candidate OpenAPI and Swagger paths. The llms.txt and markdown docs are LLM-friendly prose documentation, not a machine-readable API specification, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
